setRepeatingRequest failed: the session was closed by the HAL right after configuration.
No frames (%1$d captures started, %2$d failed)
The HAL started captures but returned no buffers: the sensor is streaming without a usable CSI link (MIPI lanes, settle count, no SOF on the VFE) or the ISP dropped every frame.
Not even a capture start: the sensor is not streaming (power sequence, MCLK, CSI PHY configuration) or the HAL is stuck before the first SOF.
%1$d frames at %2$s fps, first after %3$d ms
Only %1$d frames in 6 s: the stream stalls.
Only %1$s fps: frames are dropped or the sensor mode is wrong.
The first frame took %1$d ms: slow sensor start or AE convergence in the HAL.
%1$d captures failed: the HAL reports frame errors (ISP / CSI errors in logcat).
%1$d frames with timestamps that do not increase: broken SOF timestamps in the kernel driver.
Black frame (mean Y %1$s): lens covered, or the sensor streams without exposure/analog gain. Repeat in a lit room if the lens was covered.
Flat frame (Y std dev %1$s): no image content, typical of a test pattern or of wrong data on the CSI link.
Green frames (mean U %1$s, V %2$s, both far below 128): wrong gralloc/YUV format or chroma planes not written.
Magenta frames (mean U %1$s, V %2$s, both far above 128): wrong Bayer order or white balance gains in the sensor tuning.
No late frame could be analysed (YUV planes missing or too few frames).
